description: Negative fixture for the #2017 evidence discipline. Schema-valid on purpose: every primitive, output and stop condition is drawn from the closed vocabulary, so schemas/flow.schema.json accepts it. What it drops is verify-findings and human-escalation, which lets a claim that a source is stale or missing reach derive-gate as a verdict — the exact failure the acceptance criterion forbids. A pass in tests/flow-definitions.test.mjs would mean nothing enforces it any more.
